 Print As the game inside the Bigg Boss 20 house gets intense, contestants Uditi Singh and Arishfa Khan were seen guessing the Top 5 of the show. During the live streaming of the show, the two were seen discussing the finalists of the show. A conversation unfolded inside the Bigg Boss 20 house when Uditi shared her top five predictions with Arishfa. Recalling a discussion with Mahhi, Uditi revealed that when asked to predict the contestants who could make it to the top five, she had named Gullu, Qazi, Scout, Arishfa and Mahhi. Uditi clarified that her predictions were based on her observations of the game so far and did not necessarily reflect whom she personally wanted to see in the top five. However, she added that she did wish for Arishfa to make it to the final five, making her prediction a moment of encouragement for her fellow housemate. When Arishfa questioned Uditi about why she considered Scout a strong contender, Uditi explained that his popularity as a gamer and his large fan following could work in his favour. She believed his existing audience made him a strong player in the competition. Talking about Bigg Boss 20, the show recently witnessed Qazi Touqeer mocking Aasif Khan's medical condition. Aasif's wife shared a heartfelt post revealing about, the actor suffering a heart attack at the age of 34. She penned a note on social media on Thursday, "Yes, Aasif had a heart attack. A massive one. At just 34. It breaks my heart that I now have to share his medical reports just to prove what he went through was real. I never imagined something so personal would have to be made public for people to believe him. (sic)" She clarified that when Aasif initially said it was GERD and not a heart attack, it was out of fear, as he was worried that a serious health condition would cost him work. "In an industry where opportunities are uncertain, especially without backing, that fear was real", she further wrote. Recalling the challenging time when Aasif was in the ICU, she shared, "I will never forget being told his main coronary artery was completely blocked, the ICU, the stent, or holding my husband as he cried, afraid of losing the future he had dreamed of. Aasif had already lost his father to a heart attack as a child. Surviving one himself brought back that heartbreak and the fear of leaving his own family behind." Expressing disappointment that Aasif's health was turned into a joke, she added, "This has gone beyond criticism. We have faced vile abuse, death threats against Aasif and rape threats against our family. Nothing can justify this." "Bigg Boss is an entertainment reality show. When did entertainment become an excuse for cruelty? When did disagreements become a reason to threaten someone’s life or target their family?", concluded the post.
